The **pdf-field-editor** skill is ready. Here's what it packages up from the work we did today:

**What the skill does:**
Handles replacing any text value in a PDF — including text that is visually rendered but not selectable (vector path / outline glyph fonts, which is what those 1199A forms used). It covers single-file edits, multi-page edits, and batch edits across multiple PDFs.

**Three bundled scripts:**

| Script | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `probe_area.py` | Renders a zoomed clip of any PDF page to a PNG so you can visually pinpoint the exact coordinates of the text to replace |
| `replace_pdf_text.py` | Covers the old text with a white redaction rectangle and writes the new text on top — single file, any pages |
| `batch_replace.py` | Takes a `jobs.json` config and runs the replacement across multiple PDFs in one pass (exactly what we did for the three 1199A forms) |

**The skill will trigger automatically** the next time you ask to edit a field value in a PDF, change a TIN/ID/date/name in a document, or update the same field across multiple files.
